title: English translation of the contract and its traceability
classification: Patch: wording translated from French to English with no intended behaviour change; author assessment, not a tool-verified semantic equivalence
reason: The repository is published for an English-speaking audience. The French 1.0.0 text stays available, byte for byte, under history/1.0.0.
changed_clauses: Every prose field of every clause is translated; identifiers, structure, priorities, clause order, observation links and traceability bases are unchanged. The French text of each clause is the archived 1.0.0 contract; the English text is this candidate.
translated_labels: Entity lifecycle labels, actor names, glossary terms and quality-attribute names are translated. An implementation that exposes the French labels verbatim keeps its 1.0.0 pin or maps them explicitly.
